title: Credit Review Policy: Changes to a FlexLine Credit Limit
content:
The credit limit of a line under FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit changes only on the following terms.

## Clauses in force

1. **Status.** The limit can be changed only on a line in active status, as Larkspur's record of that line shows.
2. **Seasoning of an increase request.** An increase request is taken only when the current date is at least the tier's minimum months after the open date. Months are counted as whole calendar months from the open date, and when the later month has no matching day the last day of that month is used.
3. **Decreases.** A decrease is granted as requested, effective immediately, but never below the outstanding balance or the tier's minimum limit.
4. **Declines.** A request that does not meet these rules is declined.

The lowest limit a decrease can reach is therefore the higher of the tier's lowest credit limit and the outstanding balance.

## Clauses no longer in force

The following clauses are **no longer in force**; they are superseded by the current basis:

> A borrower may ask to raise or lower the credit limit; each request is recorded and decided by credit review.

> An increase also needs at least the tier's number of consecutive on-time minimum payments and fewer than the tier's number of increase requests in the last 6 months, uses a hard credit inquiry, and is granted for at most the tier's maximum increase percent of the current limit, never above the tier's maximum limit; the tier itself never changes.

## Seasoning boundary (hypothetical dates)

The comparison is "at least", so the day the required months are reached qualifies.

| Open date | Tier months | Date the months are reached | Request on that date | Request the day before |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 15 March | 6 | 15 September | taken | not taken |
| 31 August | 6 | last day of February (no 31 February) | taken | not taken |

## Decrease (hypothetical inputs)

A FlexLine Plus line has a 9000.00 USD limit and a 6200.00 USD outstanding balance; the lowest limit a decrease can reach is the higher of 5000 USD and 6200.00 USD, that is 6200.00 USD. A request to lower the limit to 7000.00 USD is granted as requested and takes effect immediately.

superseded_clauses: A borrower may ask to raise or lower the credit limit; each request is recorded and decided by credit review.
